title: Start with Xavier’s email
caption: Open Xavier’s email on your Android phone. Find the Kingdoms & Dragons app link. Keep Wi-Fi or mobile data on.

title: Tap the app link
caption: Tap the app link once. Use Google Chrome for these steps. Otherwise, choose Open in Chrome if offered, or copy and paste using the next steps.

title: If needed: copy the link
caption: Return to the email. Touch and hold the app link, then choose Copy link address or Copy link.

title: Open Google Chrome
caption: Find the round red, yellow, green and blue Chrome icon. Tap it to open the browser.

title: Paste and open the link
caption: Tap Chrome’s address bar. Touch and hold, then choose Paste. Tap Go or the arrow on the keyboard to open the app.

title: Check the journey page
caption: Wait for Kingdoms & Dragons to load. If the link was already open in Chrome, you can start here.

title: Open Chrome’s menu
caption: Tap the three vertical dots next to the address bar. The address bar may be at the top or bottom, depending on your settings.

title: Choose the install option
caption: Look for Install and create shortcut, then Install. Other Chrome versions may say Install app or Add to Home screen.

title: Confirm installation
caption: Tap Install in the confirmation box. If your phone offers a shortcut instead, tap Add and follow the placement instructions.

title: Give it a moment
caption: Allow the phone a moment to finish. Then go to your Home Screen using the Home button or your usual swipe-up gesture.

title: Find the new app
caption: Look for the K&D102 icon. Swipe between Home Screen pages. If you do not see it, open your app list and search for it.

title: If needed: place the icon
caption: If the app is only in your app list, touch and hold its icon. Choose Add to Home, or drag it onto the Home Screen.

title: Tap to open your journey
caption: Tap the new icon. You can now open the journey without returning to the email. Travelers do not need Xavier’s TD Login. Keep internet on for current updates.

title: If Install is missing
caption: Make sure the page is open in Chrome, not an email preview. Try a normal tab and reload. Check the app list first: Chrome may show Open app if it is already installed.
